task_id_scope: unique across entire dataset including all dates
goods_identity: one stable ID across receipt/storage/transport/handoff/shipment; at most one inbound and one outbound in current reference contract

timestamps.format: ISO8601 with explicit numeric offset (e.g. +08:00) and integer-second precision

capacity.admission_wait_behavior: keep original release, preserve waiting demand outside received inventory; no deleting demand, fictitious placement or map expansion

reference_validation.scope: logical release-order per-slot inventory/dependency plan; does not prove actual runtime timely feasibility

dataset_algorithm_separation.runtime_parameters_file: separate explicit experiment config, not task input

implemented_generator_profiles.uniform: independent fixed initial phase per active slot and periodic turnover
implemented_generator_profiles.hotspot: nearest physical 20% active slots have 4x default turnover; total is not matched to uniform
implemented_generator_profiles.continuous: exponential interarrival after initial random phase; one-second minimum

deadline_provenance: declare reference distance, handling, slack and speed; never fill input deadline from measured completion; do not alter original acceptance-case deadlines

LaDe_relation.inspiration: CSV organization with date/time/spatial task information, as used by LaDe/KG_Embodied
not_claims: not a 17-column Jilin raw CSV adapter
not actual Jilin warehouse ground truth
city delivery counts are not identical warehouse inbound volume
LaDe_relation.if_real_curve_is_used: declare source dates, scaling factor and semantic mapping in manifest

sample_input.role: small interface/reference-validation sample only, not a successful simulation report

colleague_delivery_checklist: exact seven-field tasks.csv and two-field initial_inventory.csv
declared deadline rule and expected overload labeling
reference validation plus separately recorded actual-run results
